_about: The play bot's seeded bugs (run.sh --selftest): each one a ref (or a ref + a patch under seeded/) the bot must catch, by the finding named in `expect` (a field that starts and ends with / is a regex). A bug it misses means the bot is broken, not the game fixed. The first three are the phone bugs of 2026-11-04/05 at the commit before their fixes; the fourth (a win with no 所得 — on the phone it was the native screen) is put back on the page by a patch; the hand's floor (hand-too-small) is squeezed by one and kept by its control; a picture that is not there (art-missing) is made so by a patch and kept by its control. An entry with `absent: true` is a control (the same play with the bug not there must NOT raise the finding). A `ref` of HEAD is the checkout the selftest runs from: a control that the page under test stays right (2026-11-16, the story-win 所得 cases).

bugs.note: Hanli 11-04: 狼 kept at 上山路 — the 饭桶 from the 储物袋 refused a bare 「斗法未完」 (fixed e20846c1)
Hanli 11-05: six cards fanned so deep the cost gems sat on each other (fixed 4b14bd09)

Hanli 11-04: 痒痒针 spent 灵力 on an empty rank — the bug is a rank spell (痒痒针's sweep, 震怒's the same) taking 灵力 with nothing on the rank; either card caught counts. He holds only these two cards (--deck), so the first hands have them; cards untried on an empty rank are played first, and the fights stop when it is caught (--until) — six at the longest. Before 2026-11-15 the deal decided: at this ref the fight deck is every card held (28), and four fights caught it about two runs in three, twelve only in the twelfth
Hanli 11-04: a win showed no 所得 (phone native). The patch puts it on the page: the 所得 card never drawn, and his blows land for 999 so the first fight is surely won
The page's own 11-05 bug, found by the bot: a won 降妖 and the scene's next board dealt over the stage at once, 所得 never shown (fixed dcab26ad). The patch only makes the win sure.
The control: the same sure win after the fix — 所得 shows, the check stays quiet.

Gate 11-07 at 375: the 杀招 line, both ranks full and the 丹 row at once squeezed the wheel's centre card to 65×90 — 青光's name cut, its words under 气血已满 (fixed 94b26505). The patch pins the hand at 130 px, so every fight's centre card is ~82 px tall
The control: the same fight at the fix, no patch — the centre card stands at its floor (128 px), the check stays quiet.

A picture the page asks for and does not get (the guard before art leaves the package, 2026-11-15): the patch points 后山's painting (backdrops.json places.houshan) at a file that does not exist; the first 降妖 is fought at 后山, so its stage asks for it
The control: the same fight without the patch — every picture it asks for is there, no art-missing

The gap of 2026-11-16 (the builder: 「赢了给的都要显示」): the page before the fix, at 09-lingcao's 犰狳 — the fight's settle pays nothing of its own (no 符: the patch), the story step after it pays 修为 (the stretch's whole) and 20 灵石, and no 所得 shows them (灵石 only as a reveal card, 修为 only on the bar). One card owed both. The patch also eases the 犰狳 (hp 3.1 → 0.6) so the fight is won and its 所得 checked, never quiet by a loss.
The control: the same content on the page under test — one 所得 holds the step's 修为 and 灵石. The patch also eases the 犰狳 (hp 3.1 → 0.6) so the fight is won and its 所得 checked, never quiet by a loss.

A story fight past 入门 that gives nothing at all (the patch: no 符, no 符 counted spent, the step pays nothing) is listed, not hard: every story fight from 入门 on is meant to pay something (design.md § 所得). The patch also eases the 犰狳 (hp 3.1 → 0.6) so the fight is won and its 所得 checked, never quiet by a loss.
The control: the same empty win owes no card — no hard no-spoils. The patch also eases the 犰狳 (hp 3.1 → 0.6) so the fight is won and its 所得 checked, never quiet by a loss.
The prologue is exempt (the builder, 2026-11-16: 「入门前不发」): its story fights (00-fox, 00-longzhi) won with no 符 raise neither no-spoils nor story-win-empty. The first chapter is played (--art=core).

A story fight that paid (a 符 on every win — the patch makes the roll sure) and whose 所得 the page never draws is a hard no-spoils, in the prologue too. The first chapter's story fights are played (--art=core).
